verdict.rationale: Terraform has no native natural-language command interface. However, its first-party Terraform MCP server lets AI models perform workspace operations (create, update and delete workspaces, variables, tags, run management) and generate configuration. That gives users natural-language operation only through a separate AI client and only for HCP Terraform/Enterprise workspaces and registry lookups. Missing for 10: a built-in natural-language command interface in the CLI or product, natural-language control of core CLI workflows (plan/apply/state/import), and hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.
